# Third-party files

Copied here (instead of loaded from a CDN) so the site works on networks that block CDNs.

| File | From | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `peerjs.min.js` | [PeerJS](https://github.com/peers/peerjs) (`node_modules/peerjs/dist/peerjs.min.js`) | 1.5.5 | MIT |
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) (`node_modules/qrcode-generator/qrcode.js`) | 1.5.2 | MIT |

To update: `npm install --save-dev --save-exact peerjs@<version>` and copy the file again.
